title: Hrushevsky Street
summary: Hrushevsky Street is a street name predominantly found [[coal-in-ukraine|in Ukraine]], honoring the prominent Ukrainian historian and political figure Mykhailo Hrushevsky.

sections.heading: Commemoration of Mykhailo Hrushevsky
paragraphs: Hrushevsky Street is named in memory of [[mykhailo-hrushevskyi|Mykhailo Hrushevsky]], who played a significant role in [[history-of-ukraine|Ukrainian history]] as a historian and political leader.

sections.heading: Locations of Hrushevsky Street
paragraphs: Hrushevsky Street can be found in various [[ukrainian|Ukrainian]] cities, including [[kyiv|Kyiv]] and [[ivano-frankivsk|Ivano-Frankivsk]], reflecting its importance across the nation.
